title: Field degree for dyadic bias
statement: Let $n$, $a$, and $b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$, and define $S=\lceil nb/a\rceil$ and the field degree $D=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 S\rceil)$. If $n=2^{d-r}$, $a=1$, $b=2^r$, and $r\le d$, then $D=d$.
hypotheses_covered: $n=2^{d-r}$, with truncated natural subtraction in the exponent
